results.text: Refund Policy 1. Refunds are allowed for completed orders only. 2. Delivery longer than 45 minutes qualifies for a full refund. 3. Delivery of 45 minutes or less receives no refund. 4. Refunds above INR 1,000 require human escalation. 5.

Delivery Policy 1. Delivery slots are assigned by city and time band. 2. Delays are measured in minutes from dispatch to customer handoff. 3. Orders with delivery above 45 minutes may be eligible for full refund. 4. Customers may contact
may be eligible for full refund. 4. Customers may contact support for missing deliveries. 5. Uncompleted or cancelled orders are excluded from delivery compensation.
